author: mustafa
body:
Well the past 3 clans I've joined just fell apart when I joined them. 2 of which are Chaos Kinod and IvyCodeFTW. Now I hope to actually get into a clan that won't disband the day I join and please feel free to contact me via Skype   (mhanif62) and also some things about me will be below...

Live in Eastern Timezone
Can wall jump
Can MLG block place
Have a ping that averages at 55
Prefer defense but will take anything
Get along well with  others
Hope to get into a clan soon :D
